description:
Create a new survey titled 'Personnel Data Verification 2025' in LimeSurvey. The survey must include a question group 'Employee Details' with three specific questions configured to enforce strict data formats: 

1. 'Emergency Mobile' (Short Free Text): Must use an input mask `(999) 999-9999` to enforce US phone format, and the 'Hide tip' attribute must be enabled.
2. 'Desk Location Code' (Short Free Text): Must use an input mask `99-99-999`.
3. 'Current Annual Salary' (Numerical Input): Must have a minimum value of `20000`, a prefix of `$`, a suffix of `USD`, and be set to 'Integer only'.

Finally, activate the survey so it is ready for use. Log in with admin/Admin123!.
